subject: Deflake hashtable random fairness test (#1618)
reason: The change modifies only the unit test file src/unit/test_hashtable.c: it seeds the hashtable hash function in the test harness and relaxes the random-fairness assertion threshold to deflake the test. No runtime Valkey behaviour (commands, replies, replication, persistence, cluster) is altered, so there is nothing for a fuzzer scenario to exercise.
